title: Dry Bulk Shipping - October 27, 2026
summary: Capesize Spot Index Stabilizes but Risk Remain Abound - The recent correction Short-term Indicators in Capesize spot rates appears to have established a floor, with the index stabilizing Momentum: Negative just below the 30,000 mark after a peak-to-trough decline of over 50%. While freight futures initially tracked this downward movement, front-month contracts are now Sentiment: Positive trading at a premium to the spot index, signaling an anticipated revival in market Fundamentals: Neutral activity and thus a potential increase in freight rates. This optimism aligns with historical seasonal strength over the next two months, which typically drives rates Breakwave Dry to annual peaks.
